title: Annual Medical Deductible and Maximum Out-of-Pocket Limits Across the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
The annual medical deductible and the annual maximum out-of-pocket of each Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan are as follows, together with the member coinsurance the plan fixes for covered out-of-network care.

| Plan | Annual in-network medical deductible (USD) | Annual in-network maximum out-of-pocket (USD) | Annual combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket (USD) | Member coinsurance on covered out-of-network services (per cent of the plan allowed amount) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 0 | 4200 | 4200 | 100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 0 | 5300 | 5300 | 100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 0 | 6100 | 6100 | 100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 295 | 6700 | 11200 | 40 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 495 | 7550 | 13300 | 35 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 0 | 3900 | 9800 | 30 |

### Definitions carried by the schedule

- The **annual in-network medical deductible** is the medical deductible of the plan year for in-network care, in USD.
- The **annual in-network maximum out-of-pocket** is the annual in-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan year, in USD.
- The **annual combined maximum out-of-pocket** is the annual combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket, in USD, and equals the in-network figure on the plans written as HMO contracts.
- The **member coinsurance on covered out-of-network services** is expressed as a percentage of the plan allowed amount, and a figure of 100 means the plan pays nothing out of network.

### Points of judgement

The three HMO-form plans carry one maximum out-of-pocket figure only, the combined figure being the same 4200, 5300 and 6100 USD as the in-network figure, and each of them carries a coinsurance of 100 per cent on covered out-of-network services. On the three PPO-form plans the combined figure stands above the in-network figure: 11200 against 6700 USD on Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), 13300 against 7550 USD on Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), and 9800 against 3900 USD on Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO). Only Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) and Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) carry a medical deductible at all, of 295 and 495 USD; on the other four plans the deductible figure is 0 USD.
